summary: This 8-K reports that uniQure N.V. will submit a Biologics License Application for AMT-130 in Huntington's Disease in Q3 2026, following an FDA Type B meeting where 3-year Phase I/II data was deemed acceptable for accelerated approval. No transaction, pricing, or deal terms are involved. The filing is a routine regulatory update regarding a drug development milestone, not a corporate event like an acquisition, divestiture, or capital restructuring. It does not meet the criteria for any special-situations category.
